# Houseplant UK

> > The UK's leading online houseplant retailer offering 350k+ plants with direct grower sourcing and nationwide delivery.

Houseplant UK specializes in curated indoor plant collections, gift sets, and mystery boxes for both beginners and experienced plant enthusiasts. The site features diverse plant species from low-maintenance cacti to tropical varieties, with flexible pricing options and themed bundles.

## Shop Plants by Category

- [Indoor Plants | Houseplants | Indoor Plants Delivered](https://www.houseplant.co.uk/collections/house-plants-indoor-plants): Main indoor plants catalog with diverse species and direct grower sourcing
- [Large & Tall Plants | Houseplant UK](https://www.houseplant.co.uk/collections/large-tall-plants): Statement plants collection featuring large Areca Palms and Money Trees
- [Ficus & Fig Plants | Houseplant UK](https://www.houseplant.co.uk/collections/ficus): Ficus collection with Fiddle Leaf Fig, Rubber Plant and Weeping Fig
- [Foliage Plants | Houseplant UK](https://www.houseplant.co.uk/collections/foliage-plants): Diverse foliage plants from Areca Palms to Boston Ferns
- [Cacti & Cactus Plants | Indoor Cactus Plants Delivered](https://www.houseplant.co.uk/collections/cacti-cactus-plants): Low-maintenance cacti collection including Bunny Ears and Fishbone varieties
- [Dracaena Plants | Houseplant UK](https://www.houseplant.co.uk/collections/dracaena-plants): Exotic Dracaena collection with Fragrans and Marginata varieties
- [Calatheas & Ctenanthe Plants | Houseplant UK](https://www.houseplant.co.uk/collections/calatheas-ctenanthe-plants): Marantaceae family plants with Calathea, Prayer Plants and Ctenanthe
- [Air Plants | Houseplant UK](https://www.houseplant.co.uk/collections/air-plants): Air plant collection featuring Tillandsia species for low-maintenance care
- [Bromeliad & Guzmania | Houseplant UK](https://www.houseplant.co.uk/collections/bromeliad-guzmania): Tropical bromeliad collection with Guzmania and pineapple plants
- [Carnivorous Plants | Houseplant UK](https://www.houseplant.co.uk/collections/carnivorous-plants): Unique carnivorous plants including Venus Flytraps for pest control
- [Dried & Faux Flowers | Houseplant UK](https://www.houseplant.co.uk/collections/dried-flowers): Low-maintenance dried and faux flowers for lasting home decor
